desc: Formalize orientation variables and express each d_i in terms of cycle-edge and spoke-edge directions.
Use total edge count to show d_N is determined by d_0..d_{N-1}, so count distinct achievable prefixes d_0..d_{N-1}.
Implement the 16-relation determinized NFA DP over x_{N-1} start to count distinct prefixes d_0..d_{N-1}; accept relation containing (0,0)/(1,1); return sum mod 998244353.
Verify the implementation on sample 1 (output 14) and sample 2 (output 261339902).
Optimize the Python implementation for N up to 10^6.
